predictions.text: I predict that Proposition 39, the California voter ID initiative, will pass.
I predict that schools in Jharkhand will remain closed and the number of shelters prepared in Odisha will be around 1,700.
I predict that a prominent political figure will win the runoff election with a margin of around 52% to 48%.
I predict that Coming Up Roses will be released as a single on 30 October 2026.

I predict that the Strait of Hormuz will continue to face tensions with additional oil tankers facing incidents, and Saudi Arabia will launch another round of airstrikes in Yemen, targeting Houthi positions in Al-Jawf Governorate.
I predict that at least 100,000 people have been displaced and received assistance in Andhra Pradesh and Odisha by the end of this week.
I predict that further drone strikes in South Darfur, Sudan, will continue, with over 100 people killed and 112 more injured by the end of Thursday, 5 November 2026.
I predict that the military operations in El Tambo, Cauca will continue and expand to other regions of Colombia, particularly targeting areas near the border with Venezuela.
I predict that the Nigerian military will conduct a military operation in Taraba State, resulting in at least 62 bandits being killed.

I predict that the Spanish railway authority will identify human error as a contributing factor in the Toledo train collision and propose a mandatory training program for all railway staff, focusing on safety protocols in the central region of Spain.
